title: Implement WanJuanWang GESP C++ discovery and parsing artifact
action: Add a WanJuanWang GESP C++ ingestion script that discovers level URLs, fetches public exam HTML, parses selection/judgment/programming sections, and writes a replayable JSON artifact.
implementation: Add a package script for WanJuanWang C++ GESP ingestion.
Implement allowlist-first page discovery from the seed URL and related-paper list.
Parse `questionid`, question number, section type, stem HTML/Markdown, code blocks, options, sample sections, detail links and image URLs into a normalized artifact.
Store per-page metadata including source URL, inferred level, inferred session, content hash and fetch timestamp.
verification_notes: Live run auto-discovered 68 C++ GESP exam pages from the gecc listing.
Generated artifact contains 1836 questions: 1020 selection, 680 judgment, 136 programming.
